mapper.select: SELECT ML.YYYYMM AS yyyymm ,ML.DIVISION_CODE AS divisionCode ,ML.ISSUE_AMOUNT AS issueAmount ,ML.ISSUE_QTY AS issueQty ,ML.INVENTORY_AMOUNT AS inventoryAmount ,ML.INVENTORY_QTY AS inventoryQty ,ML.EXTRA_ISSUE_AMOUNT AS extraIssueAmount ,ML.EXTRA_ISSUE_QTY AS extraIssueQty FROM MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML WHERE ML.YYYYMM = (SELECT MAX(ML2.YYYYMM) FROM MATERIAL_INV_BAL ML2 WHERE ML2.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYyyyMm} AND #{toYyyyMm} AND ML2.ITEM_CODE = ML.ITEM_CODE AND ML2.DIVISION_CODE = ML.DIVISION_CODE AND ML2.COMPANY_CODE = ML.COMPANY_CODE AND (ML2.ISSUE_QTY + ML2.EXTRA_ISSUE_QTY) > 0) AND ML.ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode} AND ML.DIVISION_CODE = #{c.divisionCode} AND ML.COMPANY_CODE = #{c.companyCode}

SELECT SC.STANDARD_COST_AMOUNT AS standardCostAmount ,SC.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate ,SC.DIVISION_CODE AS divisionCode FROM STANDARD_COST SC WHERE SC.COMPANY_CODE = #{c.companyCode} AND SC.ITEM_CODE = #{c.itemCode} AND #{c.resolvedBaseDate} BETWEEN SC.APPLY_DATE AND COALESCE(SC.END_DATE, '99991231') ORDER BY SC.APPLY_DATE DESC
